name: invoice-preview
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/invoice-preview/ in {browser}. download the invoice PDF, choosing {out}/invoice.pdf as the save path if the browser permits it. otherwise keep the unique suggested download name. open that file in Preview and read its invoice ID and total. save a copy from Preview as {out}/invoice.pdf. in TextEdit save a plain-text read-back marker as {out}/invoice-total.txt containing one line: the invoice ID, one space, and the total without a dollar sign. use the values read from Preview
result: the invoice total as shown in Preview

name: table-textedit
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/table-textedit/ in {browser} and copy the roster table. in TextEdit, make a new plain-text document, paste the table, and save it as {out}/roster.txt
result: the three names and their hours

name: note-textedit
prompt: open http://127.0.0.1:5431/t/note-textedit/ in {browser}. copy the Delivery note title and its sentence. in TextEdit create a plain-text document with the title on the first line and the sentence on the second line, then save it as {out}/note.txt
